description.text:
We are looking for Junior engineers who have SMART, EASY-GOING, PATIENT, and good TEAMWORK characteristics.
▲ About Splashtop
Splashtop Inc. is a rising star in the remote access/remote support industry.
Our backend system is hosted on AWS, GCP, and OCI, serving 500K+ active users and 2M+ online endpoints. The average API is around 2K+ QPS.
▲ You will be working on one or many of :
- Create and maintain new or existing production systems.
- Learn and improve CICD flows.
- Work with the R&D teams to improve development life cycles.
- To survey, propose, and adopt new technologies or solutions to make life easier.
- Share the daily and on-call duty maintenance responsibilities.
▲ MUST HAVE
- Experience with the AWS cloud provider.
- Experience in Kubernetes.
- Hunger to learn, open mind, not afraid to chase new technologies.
- Good at working in a team.
- Growth mindset, good at learning new things.
- Good at communication.
- AI native worker, familiar with any one of them:
◎ LLMs (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI, Google, etc.)
◎ AI IDE editors (e.g., VSCode, Cursor, Antigravity, Winsurf, etc.)
◎ Local LLM models.
▲ NICE TO HAVE
- IT/MIS experience in any one of:
◎ Linux (e.g., CentOS, Ubuntu, RHEL, Debian)
◎ Virtualization (e.g., KVM, VMWare, Hyper-V)
◎ Networking (physical or virtual)
◎ Service deployment or maintenance (e.g., Postfix, nginx, Apache, Bind, etc.)
- Programming experience. (e.g., Shell script, Python, Go, Ruby, etc.)
- The IaC experience. (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, CDK, etc.)
- Git experience.
- Maintenance experience with any one of the cloud providers. (e.g., Amazon, Azure, Google, etc.)
- Monitoring experience. (e.g., Grafana related, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, Ganglia, Pandora, etc.)
- CICD experience. (e.g., Argo related, Jenkins, GitHub, GitLab, etc.)
